projects.title: Cow Jumper
projects.description:
An entertaining browser game where your goal is to jump over as many cows as possible!  This game was built using JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas.  It includes the following features:
- Drawing of graphics on HTML5 Canvas for a responsive, mobile design
- Touch listeners to allow for play on any kind of device
- Object oriented programming in JavaScript
- Optimized performance by persisting high score locally

projects.title: Remember The Catnip
projects.description:
A single-page task/reminder app inspired by Remember The Milk.  This app was built with Ruby on Rails on the backend and React.js for the frontend.  It includes the following features:
- Optimized load time by using customized SQL queries to obtain all tasks on initial login
- Dynamic search bar for finding partial matched task in real-time for an enhanced UX
- Google Maps API for geolocation integration
- AWS S3 for scalable cloud storage
- Backend test coverage with RSpec
